money.text: Blink twice if you mean it.
Worth it? Then go for it.
Spend on what makes you happy.
标价与实付金额可能不同
单价适合比较不同包装
总额需要把税费计算在内
折扣比例与优惠金额不是一回事
预算是事先安排可用的资金
这里的{text}要结合计价单位
Listed prices aren't always what you end up paying.
Unit prices help compare different pack sizes.
The total may include taxes on top of the price.
Discount percentages aren't the same as money saved.
Budgets plan how available money will be used.
Refunds don't always include delivery costs.
{text} needs a currency to make the amount clear.
Check the unit as well as the number in {text}.
想买先看看家里有没有
钱包瘦了胃可别跟着饿
Leave enough money for tomorrow's food.
Cheap only helps if you'll use it.
Keep some money back for groceries.
Already got one at home, haven't you?
Small savings can buy a decent meal.
Don't cut supper out of the budget.
你肯核对金额，真的靠谱！
这笔钱也想清楚再花，会过！
把价格看在眼里，你够稳！
算一算值不值，你有主见！
肯替未来的钱包想想，聪明！
You give your budget some real care!
Love that you check the price.
Nice! You're making your money count.
Look at you, weighing up the cost!
That's a careful eye on spending.
Good call, thinking before you buy.
金额再大也得交猫粮税
人类算价格，猫闻罐头喵
预算里不许删掉本座喵
贵不贵要看装几个纸箱喵
Big sum. You still owe me cat food.
Wallet for you. Dried fish for me.
Enough for an upgrade to my cushion?
You check prices. I'll sniff the tuna.
Budget cuts mustn't touch my dinner.
Value depends on how big the box is.
{text}? Let me curl my tail and judge.

deadline.text: The bell of the end tolls.
Sprint, in the name of Time!
截止时间应同时看日期与时区
工作日计时通常不包括休息日
延期需要明确新的截止点
倒计时以设定的终点计算
预计完成时间不是截止时间
优先级与紧迫程度不能混为一谈
Deadlines need a date, a time, and sometimes a time zone.
Business days leave out weekends or holidays.
Extensions need a new finish date, not just 'later'.
Countdowns measure time left until a set point.
Estimated finish times aren't the same as deadlines.
Priority and urgency don't always mean the same thing.
Does {text} mean when to start or when to finish?
Here, {text} tells us about the time allowed.
再赶也不准拿零食当饭
闹钟设好，别憋一肚子急
Remember the date. No last-minute panic.
No replacing meals with hurried snacks.
Once it's sent, go have a rest.
Alarm set? Good. One less thing to fret.
Start earlier so you can sleep tonight.
After this rush, sit down for a meal.
你记着期限，事情交你放心！
给时间留位置，你挺负责！
肯把安排理清楚，你有办法！
关键日子记在心上，你可靠！
为承诺留点余量，你周到！
把轻重缓急捋顺，你真稳！
You keep an eye on what needs doing!
Love that you plan around the deadline.
Look at you, staying on top of dates!
That's you keeping your word. Respect!
Good move, leaving a little wiggle room.
Your eye on {text} keeps us on track.
沙漏流完也不耽误午睡喵
期限再紧不能缩短摸猫喵
倒计时不如开罐声悦耳喵
You race the clock. I race to dinner.
Feed me before whatever deadline it is.
Sand runs out. My naps go on.
Busy schedule? Keep my petting slot.
Countdowns don't sound like tin openers.

name.text: A name. A face. A favor.
This name is etched in legend.
同名人物可结合职务辨认
称谓体现关系，不必等同于职位
署名说明作者或责任归属
人名音译可能有多种写法
机构名称不可当作个人姓名
尊称属于称呼，不是姓名的一部分
提到{text}时可核对姓名用字
Namesakes can be told apart by their roles.
Titles don't always tell you someone's job.
Bylines show who wrote or is responsible for a piece.
Transliterated names can have more than one spelling.
Organizations and people aren't the same kind of name.
Honorifics are forms of address, not part of a name.
Context helps work out which {text} this is.
Check the spelling when referring to {text}.
聊得再熟也别随便借钱
客气归客气，别委屈自己
Reply when you've got a quiet moment.
Check the name before you say hello.
Loans need care, even with friends.
Long time no see? Ask how they are.
Being polite doesn't mean getting hurt.
肯认真记名字，你好尊重人！
想起朋友就联系，你有心！
关系你还肯用心经营，真暖！
给伙伴留注意力，跟你合作稳！
记着人家的事，你好贴心！
You notice people. I like that in you.
Love that you remember who matters.
Look at you, making room for someone!
That's real care for another person.
Good on you for reaching out.
Your hello to {text} could mean a lot.
谁来了，给本座带鱼了吗
这个名字归我的巡视范围
New person? Did they bring fish?
You call names. I'll wait for cuddles.
Everyone should know who runs this home.
Call them what you like. I'm in charge.
Another name for my inspection list.

action.text: Read it once more, then go.
Press, and the pact is sealed.
动作需要区分执行者与接收对象
提交与批准是两个不同步骤
删除与归档的后果不同
取消通常针对尚未完成的操作
确认按钮表示接受当前选择
Actions have someone doing them and something affected.
Submitting something doesn't mean it's approved.
Deleting removes things; archiving keeps them aside.
Saving records the changes you've made so far.
Cancel usually stops something that hasn't finished.
Confirm means accepting the choice currently shown.
Check what will be affected before choosing {text}.
Here, {text} names an action you can take.
Slow down and read before you click.
Tired eyes can miss the right button.
Done here? Go get some warm water.
Wrap up before your food goes cold.
Put the mouse down. Rest your wrist.
After {text}, stand up for a bit.
你肯动手，想法就有了路！
把考虑落到行动，你很实在！
来试一试，你这股劲儿赞！
这一步愿意推进，你靠谱！
给目标做个具体动作，好样的！
Love that you're giving it a try.
Nice! You're taking a real step.
Look at you, getting things moving!
That's how you put an idea to work.
Good on you for having a go.
忙得很？尾巴偏要挡路喵
Buttons can wait. Scratch my chin.
Paws beat mice. No, I won't show you.
You do things. I inspect them.
Confirm my bowl is full first, meow.
Clicked it? Move. I want to sleep here.
Busy? A tail in your way might help.
{text} looks like it needs a paw.

revisit.text: Can't let it go, can you?
Pick up where you left off.
Going back and forth is okay.
重看一遍可对照前后变化
回到同页不代表内容没有更新
熟悉的内容也可能需要核对日期
重复阅读有时能发现遗漏
上次的结论未必适用于现在
窗口标题能帮助确认当前位置
重开{title}时可确认阅读位置
Revisiting lets you check what has changed.
Same page doesn't always mean the same content.
Familiar information can still be out of date.
Rereading sometimes turns up things you missed.
Earlier conclusions might not fit the situation now.
Window titles help you check where you are.
{app} is the name of the application you're using.
Check where you left off in {title}.
来回切也别忘锅里的菜
转了一圈该吃点东西了
Back again? Have you had any water?
Did you actually give your eyes a rest?
Window hopping won't cook your dinner.
This page stays put. You should move.
Switching again? Have something to eat.
Reading again? Don't lean so close.
Sit up when you're back in {app}.
你肯回来再看，耐心真好！
再给内容一点心思，你认真！
回头还肯捋一遍，你真会学！
还肯回来核一遍，你好仔细！
把思路接回来，你有办法！
重读也肯花时间，你沉得住气！
You came back for another look. Nice!
Love that you give it a second chance.
Hey, you're picking it up again!
Look at you, catching the little things!
That's patience, going over it again.
Good to see you stick with it.
Back in {app}? You're on a roll!
Your second look at {title} shows care.

重看可以，别打搅呼噜喵
Back again. Still haven't petted me?
Welcome back. Flatten that lap for me.
All that wandering, no fish tribute?
Bird outside is much more interesting.
Reread quietly. I'm trying to purr.
{title} for you. Warm nest for me.
